nodes.description: Internal owner address stored in BotProtected; set to tx.origin in PimpMyInu constructor and used as the only authorization gate for delegate() and list().
External bot-protection contract address used as the target of low-level external calls in the checkBots modifier and in list().
Public address of the Uniswap pair, computed in the constructor and forwarded into the external bot-protection call.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated in transferFrom and in list() without any supply accounting.
Public nested allowance mapping; written in approve and in the constructor (self/router and tx.origin/uniPair granted uint(-1)).
Fixed total supply of 1e28 tokens; never decreased, but used to compute the owner allocation in list().
Hard-coded IUniswapV2Router02 instance used by list() to add liquidity with ETH.
Hard-coded WETH/WBNB-style wrapped token address used as tokenA when deriving the pair address.
Modifier that performs a low-level call to stopTheBots with selector 0x15274141 and requires the returned success flag before executing the modified body.
Constructor that sets owner = tx.origin, derives uniPair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transfer guarded by the checkBots modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic (no SafeMath) before emitting Transfer.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with an arbitrary value.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address from the hard-coded factory address and init code hash.
Owner-only listing routine that sets balances, adds ETH liquidity with deadline block.timestamp + 600, calls stopTheBots, then overwrites balances in a loop.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization (owner checks), allowance accounting and self-approval.
Origin address used as the owner and as the beneficiary of an infinite allowance in the constructor.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp used as the Uniswap deadline in list().
delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Low-level .call() to the stopTheBots address executing before the modified function body mutates state.
Low-level .call() with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 inside list(), executed before the balance-assignment loop.
Constructor argument stored into stopTheBots.
Recipient forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
Amount forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
Debit account; also forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Credit account that receives the transferred balance.
Amount moved; also forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Spender whose allowance is overwritten by the caller.
New raw allowance value.
Caller-controlled delegatecall target address.
Caller-controlled calldata for the delegatecall.
First token used in pair derivation/sorting.
Second token used in pair derivation/sorting.
Liquidity token amount assigned to the contract balance and passed to addLiquidityETH.
Array of recipients forwarded to the bot-protection call and then credited.
Array of amounts directly assigned to balanceOf entries in the loop.
Modifier argument forwarded to the stopTheBots call.
Modifier argument forwarded to the stopTheBots call.
Modifier argument forwarded to the stopTheBots call.
Loop index iterating over _toWho/_amounts in list().
